requirements.desc: src/flow/prompts/impl/finalize-cleanup.md must not contain the pre-cleanup workflow board integration section, nor instructions to run issue-log-import or workflow add before finalize-cleanup.
requirements.note: R1: finalize-cleanup prompt no longer contains pre-cleanup board registration

requirements.desc: src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md must describe optional post-flow board registration candidate handling after the dispatcher loop exit, and the wording must state that the flow is complete and the processing is optional.
requirements.note: R2: source flow skill contains post-flow completion wording

requirements.desc: The post-flow guidance must run only when finalize-cleanup has succeeded, flow get status reports active:false, and .sdd-forge/config.json has workflow.flowIntegration equal to enable.
requirements.note: R3: source flow skill gates post-flow handling on cleanup success, inactive flow, and flowIntegration

requirements.desc: The post-flow guidance must use .sdd-forge/last-finalized-spec to locate the finalized spec on the main repo side and run sdd-forge workflow issue-log-import --spec <lastFinalizedSpec> from the main repo.
requirements.note: R4: source flow skill uses last-finalized-spec for issue-log import

requirements.desc: When post-flow candidates are present, the guidance must process only the bounded data.candidates array returned by one issue-log-import invocation, screen those candidates for board readiness, present target, problem, cause or evidence, improvement direction, and board reason for each displayed candidate, and call workflow add only for user-approved candidates.
requirements.note: R5: source flow skill screens bounded candidates and adds only approved drafts

requirements.desc: Failures in post-flow issue-log import or board draft creation must be described as post-processing failures after flow completion and must not change the flow completion state.
requirements.note: R6: source flow skill treats post-flow failures as non-completion failures

requirements.desc: Generated skill artifacts must be refreshed so .agents/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md include the new post-flow guidance.
requirements.note: R7: generated flow skills include post-flow guidance after upgrade
